newsitem.title: POLAND: IB Austria sees Kable 97 net at PLN 5 mln.
newsitem.headline: IB Austria sees Kable 97 net at PLN 5 mln.

text.p: Net earnings of the Polish cable maker Slaska Fabryka Kabli should rebound this year after a poor 1996, IB Austria securities said in its February report.

It said Kable's 1998 results would largely depend on investment plans of the company's new majority shareholder -- Danish NKT, which called a public tender offer for Kable's shares at the end of February.
IB Austria said Kable's net profit should more than double to five million zlotys this year and rise to six million in 1998 from two million million in 1996.
It predicted the company's sales would increase to 163 million zlotys this year and 185 million in 1998 from 141 million in 1996.
